newsitem.title: GREECE: Explosion rocks Athens office, police suspect bomb.
newsitem.headline: Explosion rocks Athens office, police suspect bomb.

text.p: An explosion rocked the central Athens office of the constructon workers union, causing property damage but no injuries, police said. They suspected it was the latest in a spate of bombings in the Greek capital.
The explosion occurred near central Kaningos Square, police said.

There have been a series of small bomb blasts around Athens in recent days. Most have been associated with the commemoration of a student uprising on November 17, 1973, which helped bring down a then-ruling military junta.
